description: This test ensures that all footer navigation links function correctly and lead to the expected external or internal pages. It also validates proper redirection and UI responsiveness.
steps: 2. Scroll to the footer section of the page.
4. Verify that the page redirects to https://roost.ai.
7. Verify that the page redirects to https://roost.ai/privacy-policy.
10. Verify that it redirects to https://docs.roost.ai.
13. Verify that the page redirects to https://roost.ai/docs/api.
expected_results: Links redirect to the correct pages.
No 404 or unexpected error pages are encountered.
Navigation is smooth and occurs within 2 seconds.
edge_cases: Test redirection when the target link is down (e.g., 500 error).
Verify behavior when an external link is broken.
Test for typos in link URLs that lead to incorrect pages.
Ensure links open in the correct browsing context (new tab or same tab).
data_requirements: Valid URLs for all footer links.
Simulated network failures for error handling.
dependencies: Footer links must be present and visible.
The external pages must be accessible for testing.
Admin user must be logged in.
api_interactions: Monitor outgoing requests to URLs (e.g., success statuses).
performance_metrics: Validate smooth scrolling to the footer.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure focus is visible on footer links when using keyboard navigation.
Verify correct aria-labels for screen readers.
